gloss: feeling of inferiority; sense of inadequacy

definitions.gloss: feeling of inferiority; sense of inadequacy; self-consciousness
definitions.explanation: A feeling of being inferior to others or not measuring up. Often used with を感じる (to feel).

examples.japanese: ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel inferior about my educational background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧{引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's nothing to feel inferior about.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone around me was so talented that I always felt inadequate.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧. Expresses a subjective feeling of being at a disadvantage or not being good enough compared to others. Not as strong as ⟦{劣等感|れっとうかん}→劣等感：05954_rettoukan⟧ (inferiority complex).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel inferior)
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no sense of inadequacy)
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らない→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to be no less than, to hold one's own)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{劣等感|れっとうかん}→劣等感：05954_rettoukan⟧: inferiority complex — stronger and more psychological
- {負|ま}い{目|め}: feeling of guilt, sense of obligation — involves moral responsibility rather than comparison
